title: READABLE HIT REACTIONS RETURN PATH
description: The update treats combat feel and monetization pressure as one shared pacing problem. Enemies now stagger, flash, and fall with timing that makes successful hits feel less like clerical work. Declining the shop now returns players to a smaller, friendlier offer instead of the game.
consequence: The combat log finally stopped doing all the emotional labor. The back button became a polite hallway with prices.

title: READABLE HIT REACTIONS ESCAPE ROUTE
description: The feature moves a player-facing convenience into the same room as a business goal. Enemies now stagger, flash, and fall with timing that makes successful hits feel less like clerical work. Shop exits now send players back to the last activity without a second offer or educational delay.
consequence: The combat log finally stopped doing all the emotional labor. The funnel lost a wall and several people escaped through it.

title: GROUNDED TRAVERSAL PASS RETURN PATH
description: The update makes the game easier to explain from the outside, with consequences for those still inside. Jumping, mounting, and rolling now preserve more momentum debt so movement feels heavier and more authored. Declining the shop now returns players to a smaller, friendlier offer instead of the game.
consequence: The character moves like they read the physics spec and took it personally. The back button became a polite hallway with prices.
